component.name: WriteReallyFree
component.summary: Synchronize and manage FreeWrite smart typewriter documents

description.p: WriteReallyFree is a desktop utility designed to backup and organize document files directly from FreeWrite smart typewriters over USB without requiring third-party cloud services.

ul.li: Automatic device detection and local backup sync for FreeWrite devices
Document organization with customizable folder prefixes
Automatic document format conversion (including TXT and DOCX)
Clean desktop interface with customizable themes
